report.explanation: All 12 gateway checkout observations returned 200 with durations 63-172ms; traces show successful checkout spans with no errors, and metrics show zero 502s on /v1/checkout. No fault is established by current evidence. The alert's latency figures are within normal range and do not substantiate any taxonomy cause; logs were excluded. Handing off rather than asserting an unsupported cause.
missing_evidence: Gateway logs (ev-...-gw_logs) were excluded; needed to check for errors or warnings during checkout.
